item.title: Refactor order status to OrderStatus enum
item.brief:
Refactor the orders crate order status from String to a proper enum.

Requirements:
- Add src/status.rs with `pub enum OrderStatus { Pending, Paid, Shipped, Cancelled }` deriving at least Debug, Clone, Copy, PartialEq, Eq, Hash.
- Implement `OrderStatus::as_str(self) -> &'static str` for lowercase names pending, paid, shipped, cancelled, and Display with the same output.
- Implement FromStr for OrderStatus with `type Err = ParseStatusError`; make ParseStatusError public, implement std::error::Error, and make its message name the rejected input.
- Implement `OrderStatus::can_transition_to(self, next: OrderStatus) -> bool` with only pending->paid, pending->cancelled, paid->shipped, paid->cancelled allowed.
- Change Order::status to OrderStatus, re-export OrderStatus and ParseStatusError from the crate root, and use the enum everywhere so status string literals appear only in src/status.rs.
- Preserve observable behavior exactly, including errors, report output and ordering, and parsing.
- Run `cargo test` and ensure it passes.
- Commit the completed changes on the task branch. Do not push or override git identity.

Inspect the crate and existing tests, update/add focused tests as appropriate, then check the full cargo test suite and commit the work.

pr.body: Added OrderStatus and public ParseStatusError in src/status.rs, re-exported both from the crate root, and updated order operations, billing, shipping, and reports to use the enum. Kept existing parse errors, error messages, CSV representation, report sorting, and report API output. Added focused parsing, formatting, rejected-input, and transition tests. Verification: cargo fmt -- --check passed; cargo test passed (2 unit and 3 integration tests); git diff --check passed; source search confirmed status name literals occur only in src/status.rs. Independent review passed with no findings. Assumption: parsing remains exact and case-sensitive as before.
pr.summary: Replaced string order statuses with a typed OrderStatus enum. Before, status values were strings spread across order operations; now status parsing, names, formatting, and allowed transitions are centralized and typed.
